Name: (BFAV) ALL compiled files
Author: Mazzons
Description:
[size=5]Installation guide[/size][list]
[*]download [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/updating-mods-for-stardew-valley-1-4.156000/page-46#post-3356278]BFAV unoffi﻿cial[/url]﻿
[*]download this mod.
[*]drop files on mods folder
[/list]If you don't want some enter in the main folder and delete the folder you don't want to have.



I encourage all modders of BFAV, to enjoy this mod to facilitate the people download all at once, I will give all the credits follow on [url=https://github.com/FilipeMazzon/stardew-valley-animals-for-bfav]github[/url]

I need help with pokemon, some pokemon weren't created for being a duck, chicken instead was created to be a monster, so I don't know the sizes I need to put to the sprite show properly.
to know how to edit certain pokemon please enter on content.json and change the sizes properly.
to know the format need follow the generate-data from Paritee
[url=https://paritee.github.io/#generate-data-farmanimals-entry]https://paritee.github.io/#generate-data-farmanimals-entry[/url]


Please endorse [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV)[/url] without him create the first version we couldn't make this mod.
and All contributors you liked in their mods link.

I encourage all download this mod vote in this survey, this is how I will share the percentage of rewards from nexus with the sprites authors: 

https://pt.surveymonkey.com/r/LG2RVCX

today its: 
10% to paritee
20% for me
70% divide for the other authors, I give more % for those have more download in separated mods, but in the future, I will divide looking for the survey, so please vote on all animals you liked.
